### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, every one of the 200 cases followed the same four-step sequence A02 → A04 → A05 → A06: A02's only observed outgoing transition went to A04, A04's only observed outgoing transition went to A05, and A06 occupied the final position with no observed outgoing transition. In the later window, every case followed a five-step sequence A02 → A03 → A05 → A06 → A01: A02's only observed outgoing transition now goes to A03, A03's goes to A05, and A06 now leads to A01. [DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, POS003, POS004, POS005]
- A04 dropped out of the observed behaviour: it ran exactly once in every earlier case (relative position about one-third of the trace) and in none of the 200 later cases. A03 shows the mirror image: not observed in any earlier case, it now runs exactly once in every later case at relative position about one-quarter, between A02 and A05. [OCC002, OCC003, POS002, POS003, DIR002, DIR003, REL008]
- A01 was appended at the end: it never occurred in the earlier window, while in the later window it occurs exactly once per case at the final relative position, always after A06, which had previously ended the trace. [OCC001, POS001, DIR004, REL001, REL002, REL004, REL005]
- Pairwise relations rewired accordingly: A04 previously co-occurred with A02, A05 and A06 in every case, always before them, and now co-occurs with none of them; A03, which previously never co-occurred with A02, A05 or A06, now co-occurs with all three in every case, after A02 and before A05 and A06. [REL006, REL007, REL009, REL010, REL011, REL012]
- A05 and A06 shifted from relative positions of about two-thirds and the final position to about one-half and three-quarters; because positions are counted by event order, these shifts match the longer traces (one activity exchanged early, one appended at the end) rather than an independent relocation. [POS004, POS005]
- Screening context: all 24 qualifying items come from the control-flow family, where about 0.12 would be expected if nothing had changed — roughly 200 times that expectation — and every item rests on all 200 traces of a window with an empirical strength near 0.995 (larger than in about 995 of 1,000 random re-splits). [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL011, REL012]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that the routing between A02 and A05 was rerouted: in the earlier window A04 ran once in every case between A02 and A05, while in the later window A04 is not observed at all and A03 runs once in every case in that slot, so the earlier segment A02 → A04 → A05 appears as A02 → A03 → A05. The support is direct and consistent across indicator types: trace participation flipped from 100% to 0% for A04 and from 0% to 100% for A03, A02's single observed outgoing transition switched from A04 to A03, A03 now leads to A05, and every pairwise relation of A04 and A03 with A02, A05 and A06 moved in the same direction, with each item based on all 200 traces per window. The number of qualifying items (24 against roughly 0.12 expected without change) makes chance sampling of rare variants implausible as an explanation of the pattern as a whole. An important competing explanation remains: the evidence cannot rule out that both backbones already existed as variants before the boundary and only their shares shifted completely (from all to none and none to all), and zero participation only means an activity was not observed in that window. [OCC002, OCC003, DIR001, DIR002, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL011, REL012]

Other differences: A01 was added as a new final step — in the later window A06 leads to A01 in all 200 cases and A01 closes every trace at the last relative position, whereas in the earlier window A01 never occurred and A06 ended the trace; this addition is not part of the rerouting hypothesis above. The position shifts of A05 and A06 follow from the changed trace length rather than indicating independent moves of those activities. [OCC001, POS001, POS004, POS005, DIR004, REL005]
